name: flood-viewer
description: Standalone map viewers for the flood candidate analysis: flood_viewer (traffic, trajectories, walker mesh, appliances, rain, SNS) and flood_viewer_simple (traffic + rain only)

scripts.data: python3 sample/make_synthetic.py && python3 sample/make_trajectories.py && python3 sample/make_rain.py && python3 sample/make_kaden.py && python3 sample/make_sns_posts.py
scripts.all: npm run data && npm run build && npm test
